title: One unreadable sibling checkpoint fails every boot of the epic (d23)
body:
adoptInheritedFindings reads every run's checkpoint on the integration branch (other epics' included) before filtering by epic; decodeRecord disallows unknown fields and any error aborts Run. A factory-written checkpoint newer than the local binary, or one corrupt record, stops every run of the epic at boot. Each boot also asks ClaimHolder serially per non-terminal sibling.
evidence: internal/reconcile/inherit.go:50-75; internal/reconcile/reconcile.go:1976
